text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It is finally complete, Trainer.
A devious strategy terrifying enough to send even devils running...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, I stayed up until dawn crafting this masterpiece.
I'll unleash it in our next online battle.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, our match will have to wait for another day.
Just let me sleep tonight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gotten way too worked up over planning strategies,
Rulership didn't seem to get much rest.
